title: Claude Feature 03: Research se khud deep search karwao #shorts
description:
Claude Feature 03 (Claude for Everyone): Research feature. Claude kai searches karke poori jaanch karta hai. Paid plans par, web/Desktop/Mobile. Web search ON rakho, plus button > Research. Mobile par sirf web search, connectors nahi. Usage limit jaldi kharch ho sakti hai.

Source (official):
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11088861-use-research-on-claude
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11095361-when-should-i-use-web-search-extended-thinking-and-research

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: screenshots are our own capture of the official help pages (key lines highlighted). The example prompt is an illustration. Synthetic voice.
